scripts.build: style-dictionary build --config sd.config.mjs && npm run build:themes && npm run copy-packages && npm run copy-json
scripts.build:themes: tsc -p tsconfig.themes.json && mkdir -p dist/js/theme dist/json/themes && cp src/theme/*.json dist/js/theme && cp src/theme/*.json dist/json/themes && cp types/index.d.ts dist/js/index.d.ts
scripts.copy-packages: mkdir -p packages/js/dist/js packages/js/dist/css packages/compose/dist/compose packages/ios/dist/ios && cp -R dist/js/. packages/js/dist/js && cp -R dist/css/. packages/js/dist/css && cp -R dist/compose/. packages/compose/dist/compose && cp -R dist/ios/. packages/ios/dist/ios
